title: quercus sessiliflora var. cedrorum
intro: Quercus sessiliflora var. cedrorum, commonly known as the Atlas cedar oak, is a variety of the Atlas cedar oak tree, belonging to the beech family (Fagaceae). It is known for its health benefits, particularly its antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Quercus sessiliflora var. cedrorum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
